attributes.title: Claude Code — LLM Requests
attributes.description: LLM-request events (message: claude_code.api_request) for the claude-code agent — the abstract LLM Request entity (SPEC/agent-activity-model.md). Curated model / latency / token columns; @timestamp lead, no identity. The Execution facet (span duration/outcome) and the communication/error view come later from traces and the LLM Request Errors search. trace.id is deferred to the traces diff. Constraint shown as a filter pill. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Tool Calls
attributes.description: Tool-call events (message: claude_code.tool_result) for the claude-code agent — the abstract Tool Call entity (SPEC/agent-activity-model.md). The Metadata facet: success, duration, tool name, I/O sizes, and the ungated mcp_server_scope (local/project/user). @timestamp lead, no identity; tool arguments (tool_input/tool_parameters) are audit-concern content and omitted. labels.duration_ms is a STRING label (display only). The Execution facet (span duration/outcome) and tool I/O content come from traces and the audit stream; trace.id is deferred to the traces diff. Constraint shown as a filter pill. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — User Prompts
attributes.description: User-prompt events (message: claude_code.user_prompt) for the claude-code agent. The prompt body is <REDACTED> unless OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1 — column choice is not a PII control, the field is ingested regardless. Constraints shown as filter pills. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Hooks
attributes.description: Hook-execution-complete events (message: claude_code.hook_execution_complete) for the claude-code agent — the Hooks node (SPEC/agent-activity-model.md), the runtime-outcome view. @timestamp lead, no identity; hook_source here is the coarse merged / policySettings policy flag (granular provenance lived on the now-deleted Hook Registered). hook_source, all num_*, and total_duration_ms are STRING labels (display only, not aggregatable without a runtime-field cast). trace.id is deferred to the traces diff. Constraint shown as a filter pill. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — API Errors
attributes.description: API-error events (message: claude_code.api_error) for the claude-code agent — the API failure lens and a base signal for future alerting. Columns: model, error, status_code (e.g. 529/500), attempt, duration_ms. Excludes request_id (opaque) and claude_code.internal_error (carries only error_name: Error — its substance is the paired 500-class api_error). Leads with user_email. Constraint shown as a filter pill. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Conversations
attributes.description: Per-conversation usage rollup (ES|QL over logs, one row per session.id): turns, user prompts, LLM requests, tool calls, hooks, token sums, cost. Claude's session-level companion to Turns. Events-only — trace-derived columns (precise per-turn duration, TTFT) come later once tracing is enabled.

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON:
{"query":{"esql":"FROM logs-apm.app.claude_code*
| EVAL ts_ms = TO_LONG(@timestamp)
| EVAL is_user_prompt = message == "claude_code.user_prompt"
| EVAL is_llm_request = message == "claude_code.api_request"
| EVAL is_tool_call = message == "claude_code.tool_result"
| EVAL is_hook = message == "claude_code.hook_execution_complete"
| STATS
    first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
    last_seen = MAX(@timestamp),
    duration_sec = (MAX(ts_ms) - MIN(ts_ms)) / 1000.0,
    docs = COUNT(*),
    turns = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.prompt_id),
    user_prompts = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_user_prompt, labels.prompt_id, null)),
    llm_requests = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_llm_request, labels.request_id, null)),
    tool_calls = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_tool_call, labels.tool_use_id, null)),
    hooks = COUNT(CASE(is_hook, 1, null)),
    input_tokens = SUM(CASE(is_llm_request, numeric_labels.input_tokens, null)),
    cache_read_tokens = SUM(CASE(is_llm_request, numeric_labels.cache_read_tokens, null)),
    cache_creation_tokens = SUM(CASE(is_llm_request, numeric_labels.cache_creation_tokens, null)),
    output_tokens = SUM(CASE(is_llm_request, numeric_labels.output_tokens, null)),
    cost_usd = SUM(CASE(is_llm_request, numeric_labels.cost_usd, null))
  BY conversation_id = session.id
| SORT last_seen DESC"},"filter":[]}

attributes.title: Claude Code — Turns
attributes.description: Per-turn usage rollup (ES|QL over logs, one row per labels.prompt_id): user prompts, LLM requests, tool calls, hooks, token sums, cost. Claude's turn-level companion to Conversations. Events-only — duration_sec is the first→last log-event span of the turn (an approximation, not span wall-time); ttft_sec, a span-based duration, a trace_id column, and moving the turn key to trace.id come later with the traces diff.

| WHERE labels.prompt_id IS NOT NULL
| EVAL ts_ms = TO_LONG(@timestamp)
| EVAL is_user_prompt = message == "claude_code.user_prompt"
| EVAL is_llm_request = message == "claude_code.api_request"
| EVAL is_tool_call = message == "claude_code.tool_result"
| EVAL is_hook = message == "claude_code.hook_execution_complete"
| STATS
    first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
    last_seen = MAX(@timestamp),
    duration_sec = (MAX(ts_ms) - MIN(ts_ms)) / 1000.0,
    docs = COUNT(*),
    user_prompts = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_user_prompt, labels.prompt_id, null)),
    llm_requests = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_llm_request, labels.request_id, null)),
    tool_calls = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_tool_call, labels.tool_use_id, null)),
    hooks = COUNT(CASE(is_hook, 1, null)),
    input_tokens = SUM(CASE(is_llm_request, numeric_labels.input_tokens, null)),
    cache_read_tokens = SUM(CASE(is_llm_request, numeric_labels.cache_read_tokens, null)),
    cache_creation_tokens = SUM(CASE(is_llm_request, numeric_labels.cache_creation_tokens, null)),
    output_tokens = SUM(CASE(is_llm_request, numeric_labels.output_tokens, null)),
    cost_usd = SUM(CASE(is_llm_request, numeric_labels.cost_usd, null)),
    conversation_id = VALUES(session.id)
  BY prompt_id = labels.prompt_id
| SORT last_seen DESC"},"filter":[]}

attributes.title: Claude Code — Turn Timeline (Events)
attributes.description: Per-activity events timeline (one row per event) — Claude's events-only counterpart to Codex CLI — Turn Timeline (Traces), which Claude can't build with tracing off. No filter pill and an empty query bar: Claude Code is low-noise, so every event type shows; scope to a turn interactively by adding a labels.prompt_id filter in Discover. message is the "what"; the remaining columns are the union of per-event-type discriminators (sparse per row). trace.id is deferred to the traces diff. Built on the Claude Code — Events data view.
